issueTitle: Activate unit-test reviewer shared v2 contract after bootstrap

stories.title: Materializing the reviewed v2 transaction
stories.description: Add a deterministic, fail-closed activation command that validates and copies the committed v2 manifest sources into their reviewed destinations without enabling Gilfoyle.
stories.notes: Seam: activation command output and resulting destination hashes.

stories.title: Activating v2 reviewer execution
stories.description: Switch the active unit-test reviewer runtime, registry, workflow, package scripts, and policies to the materialized v2 contract while retaining the established required check identity.
stories.notes: Seam: registry validation and protected workflow matrix.

stories.title: Calibrating the activated reviewer
stories.description: Generate a fresh real Azure calibration and required attestation for the exact activated fingerprint without weakening thresholds or reusing dormant evidence.
stories.notes: Seam: calibration validator and attestation validator.

stories.title: Retiring the dormant staging boundary
stories.description: Remove inert staging artifacts only after active materialization is verified, document the #22 proof boundary, and publish passing exact-head evidence.
stories.notes: Seam: active policy, workflow, and documentation checks.
